simple.meaning: מִכְתָּב (miktâb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a thing written , the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 9 times in Exodus, Deuteronomy, 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Isaiah, beginning at Exodus 32:16. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, commandment, kingship, prophetic witness, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִכְתָּב (H4385) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מִכְתָּב (miktâb) / H4385 is traced through Exodus 32:16, Exodus 39:30, Deuteronomy 10:4, 2 Chronicles 21:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: a thing written , the characters, or a document (letter, copy, edict, poem)
definitions.full: H4385. miktab מִכְתָּב noun masculine 2Chr 21:12 writing ; — absolute ׳מ Deut 10:4 + 5t.; construct מִכְתַּב Exod 32:16 2 t.; — 1 = handwriting הוּא אֱלֹהִים מִכְתַּב וְהַמִּכְתָּב Exod 32:16 . 2 = thing written, Exod 39:30 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb with כָּתַב ), Deut 10:4 ; specifically a royal enactment or edict (= כתם כְּתָב 4 ), 2Chr 35:4 || כְּתָב , 36:22 = Ezra 1:1 ; a prophetic writing 2Chr 21:12 . 3 in a title , ׳מ לְחִזְקִיָּהוּ Isa 38:9 Writing of Hezekiah.

occurrences.englishText: The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
The tablets were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, engraved on the tablets.
They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO YAHWEH”.

He wrote on the tablets, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which Yahweh spoke to you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly; and Yahweh gave them to me.

A letter came to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, “Yahweh, the God of David your father, says, ‘Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Judah,
Prepare yourselves after your fathers’ houses by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that Yahweh’s word by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, Yahweh stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,
